W15

Syllabus/grading summary

/courses/:courseId/syllabus
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S03, S04

Present the published syllabus and human-readable grading rules together. Identify the current policy version and distinguish the syllabus policy from a learner's released calculation.

Entry and return
Course navigation from W14W19 assessment rule linkW24 calculation explanationW11 course AI policy
Layout regions
Document headerSyllabus title, publication/update date, version and accessible download; Course term and archive/preview context
Syllabus bodyContacts, office hours, schedule, late work, resubmission and AI/tool rules; Structured grading categories with points or weights, item treatment and letter boundaries
Policy summaryEqual versus point-proportional item weights; missing/ungraded/excused treatment; Empty category, rounding, extra-credit and policy-change explanation

Stay on current versionOpen selected published version
Permissions
  • TAs may read operational rules but cannot change grading policy or release.
  • Students see only published versions and their own grade links.
  • Institution-wide AI allowance never overrides stricter course rules.
Responsive
  • Category tables become labelled stacked rows; preserve weight and method labels.
  • Document viewer has full-width open/download alternatives.
Accessibility
  • Accessible text alternative accompanies the syllabus PDF.
  • Headings, linked contents and properly scoped category table headers support navigation.
Data
  • Published syllabus asset/version and structured grading policy.
  • Category mapping, weighting method, status treatment and course AI rule.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Category weights and calculation labels match W24 and published W52 output.
  • Missing policy never produces a fabricated overall grade.
  • A failed PDF load retains readable grading/AI rules and a retry path.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
